scope: Native admission diagnostics only; authentication, custody gates, presentation order and WorkManager return semantics preserved

causeBoundary.interpretation: WorkManager SUCCESS does not prove admitted/presented. Existing implementation always reports success after native execution, including nonadmitted/error paths. Retained earlier logs cannot distinguish the853ms attempt disposition.

causalTests.before: Two new behavior tests failed because no native admission start/result event was produced.
causalTests.after: 19 focused admission tests and78 native preservation tests pass; exact5 dispositions, each custody bit, timeout/exception, private-input exclusion, diagnostic-only operation ID and throwing sink preservation are covered.

wireChange.timing: Per-operation durationMs uses a monotonic clock; events carry a random diagnostic-only operationId.
wireChange.privacy: Raw call/wake handles and invocation nonces are never event fields; exception text is never recorded. Private handle is used solely as native trace lookup input.
wireChange.authority: Diagnostic metadata does not grant admission; nonce+identity+persistence+database+lease+expiry checks remain required.

limitations: The exact root cause of the retained853ms attempt is not recovered by adding future diagnostics.
Deferred remains reasonunknown unless the producing Dart path supplies trustworthy typed diagnostic context; no owner failure is inferred.
New schema must be deployed before new native events are uploaded.
Live final diagnostic attempt remains root-coordinated and pending.
